Retrieve all valid plotting symbols for the plotly library

Source: R/Plotting_Symbols.R
Symbol_List.Rd

Retrieve all valid plotting symbols for the plotly library

Usage

Symbol_List()

Value

A vector of all the valid plotting symbols used in the plot_ly library.

Examples

Symbol_List()
#>   [1] "0"                           "circle"                     
#>   [3] "100"                         "circle-open"                
#>   [5] "200"                         "circle-dot"                 
#>   [7] "300"                         "circle-open-dot"
